watches.name: Swisseleton
watches.description: This watch was hand-assembled, regulated, and tested in Singapore. Model: Swisseleton Case diameter: 42mm (without crown) Case thickness (from crystal to caseback): 11.5mm Lug width: 20mm Case material: 316L stainless steel Crystal: Mineral glass Water resistance: Splash-resistant; strictly no water activities (swimming, showering etc.) Movement: Swiss-made ETA Unitas 6498 (regulated) Power reserve: Approximately 56 hours Movement winding: Manual crown winding Strap: Quick-release suede strap The Swisseleton comes with a decorated Swiss-made 6498 skeleton beauty, a brushed/polished 316L stainless steel case, Swiss-made Super-LumiNova gunmetal hands, and a comfortable quick-release teal suede leather strap. More often than not, fancy watch boxes are either thrown away upon arrival or kept away for a long time. Due to environmental and sustainability concerns, all my watches come with a compact reusable storage box with inner foam protection. With this, you can reuse the box for many applications, such as travelling and camping. All watch pictures are real and not rendered.

watches.name: Opal
watches.description: This watch was hand-assembled, regulated, and tested in Singapore. The Opal comes with a lab-developed opal dial, a brushed 316L stainless steel case with a Super-LumiNova indices chapter ring, Super-LumiNova hands, and a comfortable quick-release Milanese mesh bracelet. The Opal dial is translucent, revealing a subtle NH72 gunmetal skeleton movement beneath it and highlighting the beauty of the automatic movement. The opal colour play varies from photo to in person, under artificial lighting, and in sunlight. Ultimately, it reflects and shines beautifully under different conditions. It is available in 2 different colours. The stone dial is fragile and must be installed and handled with care. No dials will be entirely identical. Each stone dial will have a different pattern throughout its surface. After factory processing, some surface scratches on the stone can still be present. watches.name: Commission Watch
watches.description: All watches are built/hand-assembled, regulated, and tested in Singapore. Off-catalogue commissioned custom-built watch. All my watches are professionally lubricated and water-resistant, pressure-tested with a water pressure tester, meticulously hand-assembled with sophisticated tools, regulated with a timegrapher to perform better than factory specifications, and live-tested in Singapore, ensuring you don’t receive a faulty product but probably one of the best watches available in the price range.
